set.body:
Outcome
Extend the accepted native slice into a coherent reusable control and application composition system.

Owned scope
theme recipes; workbench; component and application sampler fixtures

Prerequisites
C1, C2, C3, C4, C5

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] C1–C5 cover the full component inventory and three realistic application fixtures.
- [ ] Applicable state combinations are explicit and render coherently in four variants, including edited/invalid/focused, disabled/selected and inactive selection.
- [ ] Optional workbench and command composition work without a docking dependency; overlay appearance and narrow-window recovery meet the contract.

Required evidence
Component/state inventory, fixture captures, keyboard/overlay and validation tests.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code E2. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [E2] Complete the native component and workbench system
